programme.title: Locked On SEC
programme.desc: Chris Gordy hosts Locked On SEC, a daily podcast dedicated to bringing SEC fans the most up-to-date info when it comes to Southeastern Conference sports. Hear from some of the conference's biggest experts and insiders that know your school inside and out.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: Who's Your Caddy?
programme.desc: Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life.

programme.title: Bad Ass 2 : Bad Asses
programme.desc: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with his agoraphobic buddy Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to clean up Los Angeles' crime-infested streets.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Precious
programme.desc: Pregnant by her own father for the second time, 16-year-old Claireece "Precious" Jones (Gabourey Sidibe) can neither read nor write and suffers constant abuse at the hands of her vicious mother (Mo'Nique). Precious instinctively sees a chance to turn her life around when she is offered the opportunity to transfer to an alternative school. Under the patient, firm guidance of her new teacher, Ms. Rain (Paula Patton), Precious begins the journey from oppression to self-determination.

programme.title: Piernas cruzadas
programme.desc: Una cantante de flamenco español y una chica tímida cambian de identidades, pues son físicamente muy parecidas.

programme.title: El Mofles en Acapulco
programme.desc: Dos bellas mujeres intentan seducir a un pobre empleado costero para que sea el receptor de un cargamento de droga.

programme.title: Guantanamera
programme.desc: Una mujer viaja a Cuba y encuentra de nuevo a su viejo novio de la infancia, quien está casado con una mujer infiel.

programme.title: El Hechizo del Pantano
programme.desc: Un niño juega en el bosque con una chiquilla y cuando su padre se entera descubren que ella murió años atrás.

programme.title: Los corrompidos
programme.desc: En un gran hotel hay de todo, una telefonista ninfómana, un recepcionista jugador y un elevadorista inescrupuloso.

programme.title: La historia de un gángster
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente que sale de prisión antes de tiempo por buena conducta, pero este vuelve a meterse en problemas y retoma la vida criminal.

programme.title: Santa Claus
programme.desc: Santa y el mago Merlín se unen para frustrar los planes del diablo de extender la tentación entre los niños del mundo.

programme.title: Pilotos de Combate
programme.desc: Unos pilotos de la fuerza aérea investigan en una misión antidrogas y descubren a un mafioso que disfraza sus negocios.

programme.title: Mansión del Terror
programme.desc: Las extrañas vidas de dos personas son unidas por el amor, pero un mal recuerdo y algunos traumas transformaron todo en una cruel pesadilla.

programme.title: Pistoleros bajo el sol
programme.desc: En un pueblo azotado por un ciclón, matan a un investigador. Su hermano, Tony, llega para hacer su trabajo y también lo atacan. Martha arriesga su vida para ubicar a los criminales.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. When the time is up, the team with the most points wins, and the non-celebrity contestants wins cash.

programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens

Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes

And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens

programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Whether by wing, fin or hoof, epic migrations are among nature's most awe-inspiring events. Animals undertake these arduous journeys, for many reasons: to find a mate, to give birth, or to move to new feeding grounds. And danger lurks at every turn. In this episode we discover the lengths they go to in order to survive.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: Ever wondered how to look after dozens of tiny turtles? This episode of An Aquatic Life will show you just that! Meet the turtle team and their amazing ambassadors, Bob, Sandy and the monstrous loggerhead, Yoshi! The collections team is running at half capacity while most of the team members collect Ragged-Toothed Sharks in East London for the upcoming predator exhibit... But with a colossal storm en route to the city of Cape Town, will it all be ready for their arrival?

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: The Lion, Africa's ultimate predator. An essay in power and agility, famed for the cut-throat gang and the killer instinct. Lions are known as the kings of the jungle yet their homeland is an open grassland rather than rainforest. In the African plains prey-rich real estate can be hard to come by, and lions work together to ensure no one claims their territory and usurps their crown.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Journey to the Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.desc: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself.

programme.title: Daybreakers
programme.desc: Ten years after a plague turns most of the world's population into vampires, a critical blood shortage causes panic and gruesome mutations among the reanimated. Edward (Ethan Hawke), a vampire hematologist, tries to develop a blood substitute when he meets Lionel (Willem Dafoe) and Audrey (Claudia Karvan), two fugitive humans who claim to have a possible cure. Edward casts his lot with them in the hope of perfecting the cure before it's too late.

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Two centuries after Dr. Frankenstein assembles and reanimates his creature, Adam is still living. He becomes embroiled in a war between two immortal races: gargoyles, the traditional protectors of mankind, and evil demons. Since Adam is neither human nor demon, gargoyle Queen Leonore and demon Prince Naberius each want him for their own purposes. It is up to Adam to discover his inner humanity and the reason for his continued existence.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Without remembering how they got there, several strangers awaken in a prison of cubic cells, some of them booby-trapped. There's onetime cop Quentin (Maurice Dean Wint), scientist Holloway (Nicky Guadagni), young math genius Leaven (Nicole de Boer), master of escapes Rennes (Wayne Robson), autistic savant Kazan (Andrew Miller) and architect Worth (David Hewlett), who might have more information on the maze than he lets on. The prisoners must use their combined skills if they are to escape.

programme.title: Cube 2: Hypercube
programme.desc: A group of strangers wakes up in a sealed room with no means of escape. The eight people -- Kate (Kari Matchett), Simon (Geraint Wyn Davies), Sasha (Grace Lynn Kung), Max (Matthew Ferguson), Jerry (Neil Crone), Julia (Lindsey Connell), Mrs. Paley (Barbara Gordon) and Col. Maguire (Bruce Gray) -- must find their way out of the room. But more rooms await them, and each one is increasingly dangerous. Also, it appears physical laws do not apply in this strange and deadly environment.

programme.title: Cube Zero
programme.desc: A monitor (Zachary Bennett) decides to help a captive (Stephanie Moore) escape from a structure in which trapped occupants meet ghastly deaths.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: To celebrate his 30th birthday, Tyler and his six friends try an escape room challenge. The special mission for escaping a room in one hour starts, and the members immediately notice that the challenge is deadly and difficult.

programme.title: Prey for the Devil
programme.desc: The Roman Catholic Church combats a global rise in demonic possessions by reopening schools to train priests to perform exorcisms. Although nuns are forbidden to perform this ritual, a professor recognizes Sister Ann's gifts and agrees to train her. Thrust onto the spiritual frontline, she soon finds herself in a battle for the soul of a young girl who's possessed by the same demon that tormented her own mother years earlier.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism
programme.desc: After years of gulling the faithful, cleric Cotton Marcus feels remorse and decides to expose his chicanery through filming a documentary. With a crew in tow, Marcus arrives at the Louisiana farm of devout Louis Sweetzer, who believes that his daughter, Nell, is possessed. When the usual stunts fail, he realizes that he is face-to-face with real evil and must summon true faith to protect Nell, the others and himself from demonic power.

programme.title: Zack and Miri Make a Porno
programme.desc: Lifelong friends and now roommates, Zack (Seth Rogen) and Miri (Elizabeth Banks) are buried under a mountain of debt. When the electricity is turned off, they realize that desperate times call for desperate measures. They decide to make an adult film to raise some cash. Though they swear that having sex will not damage their friendship, their business proposition quickly turns into something much more.

programme.title: Jay and Silent Bob Reboot

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.desc: In the summer of 1967, rioting and civil unrest starts to tear apart the city of Detroit. Two days later, a report of gunshots prompts the Detroit Police Department, the Michigan State Police and the Michigan Army National Guard to search and seize an annex of the nearby Algiers Motel. Several policemen start to flout procedure by forcefully and viciously interrogating guests to get a confession. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel. Built in 1902, the establishment is brimming with frequent sightings of numerous apparitions. These include a little boy named Billy, who is believed to have drowned in a nearby river. Some of the most startling encounters have taken place in the "Julia Lowell Room" where, long ago, a woman of the same name committed suicide.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Vermont, a terrified family calls upon TAPS for assistance with startling paranormal events that are taking place in their home. Since they began renovating, the Johnsons have repeatedly seen so-called "shadow people" moving through their house. One night while sleeping, Sean Johnson, the patriarch of the home, was attacked by forces that cannot be seen.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Massachusetts, TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity. The historic home recently underwent a stage of renovation which seems to have stirred up an abundance of paranormal phenomena. The homeowners have seen a number of apparitions dressed in period clothing throughout the mansion. Mysterious voices and strange noises have also been a common occurrence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Hundreds of years old, the historic grounds are said to be the home to numerous malevolent spirits, but none more frightening than a mysterious entity known as the "Elemental". Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. These ancient ruins of a grand yet cursed estate are reportedly home to "fairies", troll-like spirits that live underground and wreak havoc on those who trespass. During an intense investigation, the team sets out to learn the truth behind the legends. What was already an unusual investigation turns to panic as TAPS realize they are being hunted by something from the beyond.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this terrifying episode, TAPS investigates The Hellfire Caves, an elaborate maze of underground caves in rural England. The caves served as the center for a secret satanic society hundreds of years ago. Politicians and other influential people of the era used the deep caves to escape persecution and keep their religious practices shrouded in the utmost secrecy. Today, the eerie history of the caves has manifested into numerous accounts of startling paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to the aid of a family in Chesapeake, Virginia terrified by the arrival of paranormal activity in their home. Ever since the Keffers began remodeling, they have been plagued by bizarre events. These include the unexplained movement of antique dolls and the sighting of apparitions dressed in period clothing. The Keffers' situation is compounded because they are members of the Mennonite religious community.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A battle scarred warship sets the stage for one of TAPS' largest investigations to date. Docked in Corpus Christi, Texas, the U.S.S. Lexington served in many missions during World War II. Over 300 people lost their lives while serving on the ship, and many witnesses claim these lost souls remain onboard. Countless visitors to the Lexington have seen apparitions dressed in military uniform.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to Hollywood for a pair of unforgettable investigations. The first stop for the team is the site of one of the most horrifying crimes in American history. In 1969, five people were brutally murdered by members of the Charles Manson religious cult, including actress Sharon Tate and her unborn child. A homeowner who now lives 200 feet from the site of those crimes is convinced the victims haunt his Hollywood Hills home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS investigates the historic Presidio in San Francisco. Both employees and members of the military have reported ghostly encounters at this former military fortress. Strange tapping noises, phantom footsteps and sightings of a ghostly female apparition in Spanish attire are just a few of the chilling stories. The TAPS team is left to wonder if there are former soldiers still walking the halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode TAPS is called in to help out a family with an extremely sensitive case. When Krista Gibbons lost her sister she quickly took in her young niece, but soon after the family began hearing the sounds of footsteps in the hall and even witnessed the sight of a black limbless mass wandering throughout the house. The family wondered if their loved one had returned or if this ominous figure was something more sinister.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever TAPS comes to the aid of a priest whose home is a source of unexplained activity. Both Reverend Jennings and her parishioners have heard footsteps in the hall ways, the sounds of crying children and have seen objects moving by themselves. An unusual mark scorched into her bedroom floor baffles the team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: An urgent call from Dave Tango's father sets the scene for the next case. William Tango, an ex-cop and amateur ghost hunter, was baffled by unexplainable events he experienced on a recent trip to the Burlington County Prison in Mt. Holly, New Jersey. The TAPS team soon discovers William is not alone. Once the site of numerous executions, the prison maintains an unmistakable feeling of dread.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

programme.title: SPY KIDS 4
programme.desc: Marissa Cortez Wilson is a retired spy who keeps that identity hidden from her clueless husband and whip-smart twin stepchildren, Rebecca and Cecil. When a villain called Timekeeper threatens to conquer the world, Marissa springs back into action as head of the OSS, home of the now-defunct Spy Kids Division. With help from some gadgets and two former spy kids, Rebecca and Cecil join the fight to save Earth.

programme.title: Larger Than Life
programme.desc: Jack Corcoran (Bill Murray) is a struggling motivational speaker who lives by the mantra Get over it! When he learns his circus clown father has died and left him Vera, an 8,000-pound elephant, as an inheritance, he considers only one option: selling his father's beloved pet. He finds two buyers -- but must then get Vera to California, thousands of miles away, in just five days. With the help of an eccentric truck driver (Matthew McConaughey), Jack and Vera set out on one crazy road trip.

Leaving family and boyfriend behind to pursue her dreams, fish-out-of-water Holly comes up against fierce competition and elitist attitudes from her classmates. But with the support of her mother, Wanda (Virginia Madsen), and roommate Ditz (Jackie Rosenbaum), Holly overcomes all obstacles in her path to become the next big pop star.

When she gets an account that requires frequent trips to New York and her husband gets a new job, Kate finds herself spread even thinner. Complicating Kate's life even more is new business associate Jack Abelhammer (Pierce Brosnan), who throws temptation into the mix.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.sub-title: Speeding Up the Attack: The Marshalls

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: In this The Big Picture documentary film we watch as several companies of the 24th Division fight the Communist Chinese against great odds. They are fighting the first thrust across the 38th Parallel in Korea.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: The First Forty Days in Korea

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: The leaders of the world's future superpowers hold a conference in the Crimea to agree a post-war framework for Europe, and must overcome deep political division to do so. Meanwhile, in order to hasten the defeat of Germany and save millions of lives, the allies conduct an area bombing mission against a German city that will spark controversy for decades.

programme.title: Troopship Tragedy: The Sinking Of The SS Mendi
programme.desc: February 1917. To provide logistical support to WWI troops, a troopship of volunteers from the South African Native Labour Contingent is sent to France. The men never arrive. A story endures of the final hours before the volunteers drowned, when a charismatic Xhosa priest called the men to dance a warrior dance on deck as they ship sunk into the freezing water.

programme.title: Battle For The Atlantic: Greyhound vs Wolfpack - Western Approaches
programme.desc: Western Approaches is a vast area of ocean control covering thousands of square miles of the Atlantic. In these waters is set this single incident in the fiercest and longest sea battle in history. The players are not professional actors but serving officers and men of Allied Navies and Merchant Fleets. This film is dedicated to them and their comrades who made the Allied victory possible.

programme.title: Broken Arrows: The Lost Bombs of the Cold War
programme.desc: The 1966 Palomares B-52 crash occurred on 17 January 1966, when a B-52G bomber and a KC-135 tanker collided. The damage and radiation still exists to this day. In 1968 a B-52 bomber near Thule Air Base in Greenland crashed onto sea ice in North Star Bay. The explosives aboard to detonated and the nuclear payload to rupture and dispersed, resulting in radioactive contamination.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: At Nuremberg, Hitler's closest allies faced judgment for crimes against humanity. Yet under Nazi law, these acts were legal. This episode examines how Hitler reshaped the justice system, exposing the pivotal role jurists played in transforming law into an instrument of terror.
programme.sub-title: A Justice of Terror - Part I: Perverted Law of Terror

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific examines the growth of independence movements in Asia in the wake of World War II. In the Dutch East Indies, Sukarno declares Indonesian independence and defeat Dutch efforts to retake their colony. In India, the British hands over control to Jawaharlal Nehru. The two new nations soon come to conflict in the region of Kashmir.

programme.title: Military Legends of World War II
programme.desc: The President of the United States, in the name of the U.S. Congress, has awarded more than 3,400 Medals of Honor. This is the story of the acts of bravery and heroism that the medal honors.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: A day by day documentary on the preparation of US troops prior to the D Day invasion and the immediate aftermath after the successful capture of the Normandy Beaches.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: After years of war, the defeat of Hitler and the Third Reich is inevitable. Peace in Asia will follow peace in Europe after the detonation of the atomic bomb.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won & Lost
programme.desc: The battles of the WWI were battles of attrition, opposing armies hardly moving between lines of trenches. The battles of WWII were much more dynamic: The Battle Of France, Kursk, Iwo Jima, the Siege of Tobruk and Operation Crusader.
programme.sub-title: Blitzkrieg, Commando Raids, Landings, Desert War

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Depicts the 'Tropic Lightning'' 25th Infantry Division; its history, and its exploits in Vietnam as a combat unit and a nation-building force.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: In the fall of 1944, an isolated Allied platoon takes refuge in a deserted village. A French woman, 'Madame Frou Frou,' warns them about hidden Germans, helping the Allies capture the village. She then asks for their help to rescue her husband from Epinay but mis-directs them to a German command post, where they thwart a counter-offensive and reunite her with her husband. Stars actor Jim Hutton.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: A Russian pilot gets captured by Germans but meets a friendly soldier who offers a chance to defect. The pilot resists at first but ultimately agrees. Meanwhile, back at the Soviet base, plans are made for a daring aerial deception to defeat the Germans. The pilot's loyalties and the success of the mission hang in the balance.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: This film documents the buildup to the Vietnam War, from the withdrawal of French troops to the bombings of the U.S. Embassy and the intense fighting our troops engaged in to combat Ho Chi Minh and the Viet Cong. The footage features President Lyndon Johnson, Secretary of State Dean Rusk and Secretary of Defense Robert McNamara.

programme.title: Hunting Down The Nazis
programme.desc: Simon Wiesenthal, a survivor of the death camps, is hunting down his torturers, from the camp Kapos to Mengele, the mad doctor of Auschwitz. Lawyer and historian Serge Klarsfeld, whose father was deported and murdered, has devoted his life to searching for Nazi leaders still at large. For the first time a film recounts the story of the long pursuit of Nazis in hiding, from 1945 to the present day.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: What had seemed to be an economic recovery is revealed to have been at best fragile and the world enters a global depression of unprecedented and unmeasurable savagery. Unemployment, hyperinflation and despair are everywhere and dictators arise. Old empires - Britain and France - come under pressure throughout the extended territories that they can barely afford to police.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: A report on captivity in South east Asia during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Pee Wee Donovan became a first aid man after promising his mother he wouldn't hurt anyone. Amidst the chaos of mortar and machine gun fire during the 1944 Battle of Hurtgen Forest, he and another aid carried a severely injured soldier through enemy territory. Faced with danger, Pee Wee forgot his promise and fought bravely, leading to heroic moments that create a thrilling and heartwarming story.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The market of San Benedetto in Cagliari is the island's belly. It is one of the biggest fresh produce markets in Europe and arguably said to be the biggest fish market in Europe. A paradise for food lovers, where every stall keeper has a story to tell.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cagliari

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's show is a special celebration of Julie's favorite season, Spring! This refreshing time of year puts a smile on Julie's face focusing her cooking on springtime offerings. What better way for Julie to cook, create and celebrate this sensational season than with her crown roasted leg of lamb infused with a bouquet of fresh herbs, slowly roasted, makes the centerpiece on the springtime table!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Spring Sensations

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Julie makes her Mezze magical in a stunning and scrumptious presentation of her Lebanese cultures most famous small plates perfectly plated for her loving Lebanese family to savor! Mezze, internationally known all over the world as one of the most distinctive and delicious display of dishes to discover originating from Lebanon and Middle East. Julie Taboulie's Mezze makes entertaining enchanting.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Magical Mezze Amidst the Moonlight

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: On today's show, a fresh farmer's market is inspiring Julie to make her marvelous Makbouseh, a Lebanese-style summertime squash stew. Dragon Chow takes on the wicked Daughters of the Devil and outwits their every move, and eventually confront Kong Tien in order to avenge the death of his father.

programme.title: Chinese Boxing
programme.desc: In early Republic of China when Taiwan was still under Japanese occupation, people were oppressed, and their condition was miserable. A Kung Fu coach from China was invited to Taiwan. His name was Wan Chin-san. Mr. Wan established a Kung Fu School in a small village and refused any Japanese to be his student. For this reason, he was assassinated. When his son, Wan Ming-Chieh, heard the terrible news, he came to Taiwan in search of his father.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo
programme.desc: By the time the senior students of Gichin Funakoshi opened the doors of the Japan Karate Association in 1949, Shotokan Karate was already well established. Just six months after Funakoshi's death in 1957, the JKA held the first JKA All Japan Karate Championship and opened the door to Karate as a sport. Tatsuya Naka, 7th dan, a past winner of the All Japan Championships, is a new generation of JKA instructor.
programme.sub-title: Warriors of Budo Episode Two: Karatedo

programme.title: Last Battle of Yang Chao
programme.desc: 1645: forces loyal to the Ming are fast losing out to the Ching (Manchu). Treacherous quisling Shu Ting Kao betrays Captain Sher and takes him prisoner, as per the (Ching) emperor's orders. Sher's loyal comrades include Yuen, who is the daughter of a general recently killed in battle. Yang Chao is overrun, but Sher's comrades disguise themselves as Ching soldiers to rescue him.

programme.title: Four Infernos to Cross aka Dark Force
programme.desc: This is the story of the struggle of the Korean people under the ruling of the Japanese before World War II. Supporters of the anti-Japanese guerillas, Kang, has to retrieve some stolen money before undercover agents can infiltrate their organization and bring the rebellion to its knees.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila llama a Casillas y le pide que tenga piedad con Esperanza, porque ella no tuvo la culpa de que la DEA la capturara. Aurelio es tajante y sella su destino. Un video de Terán lo compromete.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y sus secuaces observan a Tony y Esperanza. Casillas lleva a Pina y a Juan Carlos para el intercambio por su hija e ignora sus súplicas. Castillo y Colón van al punto de la negociación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Salvatierra y Salazar llegan en helicóptero a rescatar a Esperanza, pero algo sale mal. Mónica termina su relación con Pastrana y jura acabar con Ninón, con tal de recuperar a su hijo, Isidro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Javier y Rutila se enteran del plan de los colombianos, de no venderle más coca a los mexicanos y son encerrados por Quezada. Pretenden deshacerse de ellos. Leandro quiere una alianza con Tony.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio viaja a Colombia para intentar rescatar a Rutila. Tony llega y reconoce a Javi. Por otro lado, se acercan la Felina y Raymundo. La casa de Leandro Quezada está rodeada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pastrana está en manos de Aurelio, después que Eunice lo entregara a cambio de Ninón. Como cazador a su presa, Casillas y Skinny lo persiguen. A sangre y fuego, la muerte rodea a todos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo y sus aliados del narcotráfico regresan para ser dueños del negocio y acabar con Casillas y todos los integrantes de su familia. Hieren a Ismael y Javier es víctima de un atentado.
programme.sub-title: A la caza de Aurelio Casillas

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En cadena nacional, Aurelio Casillas desafía a los narcos de Colombia y deja mal parado al presidente. Se escabulle en medio de un operativo policial. Corina le revela que es de la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La agente especial de la DEA le asegura a Casillas que no lo vendió y está dispuesta a dar su vida por él; pero Aurelio no le cree. Javi despierta, desmemoriado. Quezada prepara su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Llega la hora de la venganza y Leandro Quezada tiene la oportunidad de deshacerse de El Señor de Los Cielos y de su hija. El Cabo ordena a Jaime conseguirle una cita con el presidente.
programme.sub-title: Atacan a Casillas y a Rutila

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El negocio del narcotráfico se mueve rápido: Casillas coquetea con Maldonado en la selva y el Cabo soborna al jefe del estado mayor de México. Buscan extraditar a Aurelio y al presidente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Las narcotienditas se quedan sin mercancía y Casillas no tiene cómo conseguirla. El Cabo triunfa en el negocio y jura sacarlo de la jugada. Aurelio hace el amor con Corina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Narcos mexicanos y colombianos luchan por el dominio del territorio y la sangre corre por las calles. Aurelio mata a un policía y el Cabo ordena atropellar al Mocho para evitar que hable.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas recibe la ubicación del Secretario de Seguridad, Castillo, en bandeja de plata, tal como Corina se lo prometió. El Cabo niega la alianza de Quezada. Quiere al pez gordo solo para él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas y sus hombres raptan a Castillo y lo liberan, con la condición de que encarcele al presidente de México. Zuleta chantajea a Terán y logra que acepte la junta con el Cabo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo y el presidente pactan eliminar a Casillas. Terán obtendrá votos y control de los carteles y el Cabo su venganza. Zuleta mintió y queda en evidencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rumbo a Turquía, Casillas y Ámbar Maldonado van por negocios y desatan el juego de la seducción: el Águila blanca debe sacar el demonio que ella lleva por dentro. Corina está celosa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Quezada y sus hombres matan a sangre fría a los lugartenientes del Cabo y se quedan a cargo de un laboratorio, dejándole claro con quién debe negociar. Casillas y Ámbar pasean, como enamorados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Con una verdadera demostración de fuerza y dominio de las armas, Casillas y Maldonado huyen de los turcos en el camión de oro venezolano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para no perjudicar su campaña, el padre de Jaime le pide a Omar que, por favor, se aleje de su hijo. Corina le dice a Aurelio que la muerte de Quezada fue una farsa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas desconfía de Ámbar al leer una nota en la que lo cita en el muelle y se excusa por un asunto urgente. Un turco pasará las tres toneladas de oro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Compra la empresa donde sufrió acoso y pone a su exjefe a trabajar como pene gigante. Los duques de Sealand, el país más pequeño del mundo, se enfrentan por títulos nobiliarios y propiedades.
programme.sub-title: Venganza fálica; Los duques de Sealand

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo la llama por el nombre de su abuela, ella descubre que es su abuelo. La esposa lo espera en tierra y para que no lo atrapen con su amante, la lanza de la avioneta en paracaídas.
programme.sub-title: Enamorado de la nieta; Yo te salvé la vida

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Victoria exige que la mujer de su exesposo le pague lo que le prestó, ella alega que vive en su casa gratis. Gustavo pide el divorcio, su mujer lo acusa de matar a la hija por la herencia.
programme.sub-title: Pegado a su ex; Desaparecida por la herencia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Enyer le pide a su tío que cumpla el contrato que firmaron, él se niega porque no cuidó de su hijo. Angélica quiere abortar, cree que tiene al diablo en la barriga, su esposo busca internarla.
programme.sub-title: ¿Quién tiene la culpa?; La ecografía del diablo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un dúo de músicos urbanos denuncia que su productor los controla con un reloj que no pueden quitarse. Adrián cumple su deseo de vestirse y actuar como niña, su esposa le pide el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristian le exige a su madre el dinero que su padre dejó para sus estudios, pero ese fondo ya no existe. En otro caso, Armando y su profesora bailan tango con mucha pasión y Jenny se molesta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Camila la van a deportar por culpa de su exjefe Raúl, quien la envió en busca de mercancía y de un amigo ilegal. Mariana demanda a una periodista por informar que había defraudado al gobierno.
programme.sub-title: Viaje en deportación; A la luz pública

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis responsabiliza a Ricardo del suicidio de su hija, lo acusa de prostituirla en Las Vegas. Marta va a prisión por drogas y sus hijos se quedan con su hermana, quien no le permite verlos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tres hermanas se disputan la herencia de la madre, una dice que la división debe ser entre dos. La esposa de Santiago gana un buen sueldo, pero tienen que vivir en la ciudad más cara del país.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere desalojarlos por conflictivos, ellos creen que los discrimina. Mirela llega a un acuerdo con José para quedarse con la pensión de su padre, pero el plan se cae cuando aparece la viuda.
programme.sub-title: Odio y desalojo; The Gold Digger

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo es el ladrón y ella quiere la recompensa que ofrecen por su captura. Marina se entera de que un cura demostró que es su padre y obtuvo su custodia, quiera llevársela a Panamá.
programme.sub-title: La recompensa; Bendita sea mi padre

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Johnny sufre un accidente tras enterarse de que uno de sus hijos no es suyo. Simón y Dolores están en pleno acto sexual, cuando el esposo de ella los sorprende, le mutila el miembro al amante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anthony exige que su hermano Edgard le pague por haberlo violado. Una madre se niega a entregarle dinero a su hijo para sus estudios, ella alega que no escogió una carrera profesional.
programme.sub-title: Hermano abusa a hermano; Universidad de influencers

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liz y Joan tienen una hija albina, a quien le afecta vivir en Miami por su condición, la madre quiere irse del país. Bárbara exige que Rafael y Albert paguen por robarle sus clientes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Verónica siente que su hermana la estafó emocionalmente, incitándola a enamorarse de una amiga con quien tenía un acuerdo de sacarle todo el dinero posible. La hermana alega que nada fue premeditado. Benjamín odia a las iguanas y a los indocumentados. El estado de Florida permite dispararle a las iguanas con rifles de balines y él, alegando que le estaba disparando a una iguana, le pegó un tiro en un ojo a Iván, quién, casualmente, es indocumentado.
programme.sub-title: Duplo golpe emocional; Balines contra iguanas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Joan tiene la custodia total de su hija y Yuri descubre que la niña hace videos de "autobullying". En otro caso, la serpiente de Ángel y Rose se come al lindo perro de su vecina Katiana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El novio de Laura le cuidaba la mascota, el animal ingiere cocaína y aparece muerto. Andrés le practica sexo oral a su mujer durante la menstruación, le causa lesiones físicas y psicológicas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luz América intenta ir al funeral de su hija, pero su hermana y su madre lo impiden. Yarelis cuida a su hijo de 18 años como si fuera un bebé, el padre quiere que el chico se vaya de la casa.
programme.sub-title: Si te fuiste, a qué has vuelto; Mama's Boy

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La esposa de Armando está secuestrada por la guerrilla colombiana. Los secuestradores piden hacer un intercambio: exigen que se entregue al hijo de ella con uno de los jefes de la guerrilla y la liberan. Además, Ángel está obsesionado con ser parte de las pruebas de medicamentos que hacen las farmacéuticas. Vive de eso y lo ha sufrido porque perdió su erección en uno de los estudios.
programme.sub-title: Una vida por otra; Conejillo de indias

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Claribel quiere la custodia de su hermano con daño cerebral, porque su cuñada abusa de él por venganza. Carlos pierde un testículo por la picada de un guacamayo y responsabiliza a su esposa.
programme.sub-title: El maltratado; Paco y los calzoncillos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.

programme.desc: If aliens have visited Earth, why are they here and what are they truly after? Investigations have revealed the possibility that aliens are interested in experimenting on not only the human body, but the human mind as well.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Rapid advancements in science and technology have given mankind unprecedented access to distant galaxies that could harbor life. And some scientists believe that to find alien life we need look no further than our own backyard.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: As technology advances, more and more people are capturing images of inexplicable objects in the sky.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: In 1947, a series of UFO sightings triggers an unprecedented analysis that propels the UFO phenomenon on to the world stage. We investigate how the U.S. Air Force comes to the stunning conclusion that UFOs may not be from Earth.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: UFO sightings happen almost every day. But in the court of public opinion the most credible witnesses come from law enforcement. Join us as we investigate the most important police sightings of UFOs.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension

programme.sub-title: A Social Club for the Paranormal

programme.desc: Haunted Magpie Mines are located in the Peak District of Derbyshire. Believed to be one of the most paranormal mines in the UK. Will a ghost be caught on camera? and will any of the paranormal equipment make contact with the spirit world?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate ruins of The Orangery in Merseyside and claims that the ghost of a grey lady is haunting the location. They capture some of the most compelling paranormal evidence they have ever encountered.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension continue their investigation into Champness Hall and come face to face with paranormal activity that is caught on camera and seek out the paranormal entities haunting the location.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: In 1995, a small UK village was disrupted by a brutal fire that destroyed its town hall. To this day, no culprit has emerged - were otherworldly forces responsible?

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: This episode explores the paranormal mysteries surrounding an August 2000 Briton sighting, where police crossed paths with a strange light in the sky.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: The White Swan pub and hotel in Henley in Arden in the UK is reported to be a haunted hotspot. This former jailhouse with gallows has a gruesome history and owners Maria and Nigel believe a lady of the night who died in mysterious circumstances still roams the corridors.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Danny Moss has been charged with investigating a haunted house in Middlesbrough in the UK. Rose grew up in the house in the 1970's and 80s which was believed to have been the site of a fatal fire years earlier. She witnessed her first ghost when she was just 7 years old.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Katy from Mold, in Wales is convinced that her Party Shop is haunted be previous tenants of the 17th Century building. Paranormal investigator Lee Roberts has been enlisted to see if he can capture proof and back up claims that a ghost called Sarah, a young servant girl, is still residing in the premises.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard speaks with several independent researchers about their allegations that a powerful, secretive cabal of international bankers is attempting to rule the course of history and imprison humanity through their monopoly of the creation and control of the planet's money supply.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Is this remarkable piece of linen the actual burial cloth of Jesus Christ or a clever medieval con? Richard talks to top Shroud investigators who give the latest scientific evidence they claim proves the cloth is not only genuine, but holds evidence of a real resurrection event.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Who was actually behind a series of revolts and protests that swept the Middle East? Did social networking students really inspire these revolutions, or were these insurgencies plotted by the US State Department? Two journalists and an independent researcher/broadcaster argue the Arab Spring was more about the US State Department's desire to form client states than supporting democratic reforms.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to New York, San Francisco and Seattle to investigate claims the Twin Towers and Building 7 were brought down by explosives placed inside the towers prior to the 911 attacks. The founders of Architects and Engineers for 9/11 Truth and Firefighters for 9/11 Truth present their best evidence for controlled demolition and a Fire and Explosives expert attempts to refute their claims.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard delves into claims that the medical profession, drug companies, food industry, government agencies and other vested interests are conspiring to suppress multiple proven cancer cures.
programme.sub-title: Is the Cure for Cancer Being Suppressed?

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: From the Canary Islands to Galicia, passing through Catalonia, in very special places such as the Cañadas del Teide or on the mountain of Montserrat, witnesses and those contacted assure that UFOs have been making appearances for decades; and they claim to have proof of it!

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: These attacks are the most terrifying part of the phenomenon, and therefore, the most real. What is behind these aggressive apparitions?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Scientists have never been closer to proving that life once lived on Mars. But is it still there? And if so, how has it evolved? Join us as we investigate the red planet and the possibility that alien life may live within our own galaxy.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Scientists and Ufologists are scouring the vast regions of space for signs of extraterrestrial life. But if it takes millions of years for light from distant stars to reach Earth, how long could it take for aliens to answer our call?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Some scientists believe the survival of mankind hinges upon the revolutionary science of Artificial Intelligence. Biological life may just be an evolutionary stepping-stone in a universe dominated by Artificial Alien Intelligence.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The past few decades have been filled with stunning technological advancement. But is all this 'progress' good for humanity?
